entities.summary: A Mithraeum (Latin pl. Mithraea), sometimes spelled Mithreum and Mithraion, is a temple erected in classical antiquity by the worshippers of Mithras. Most Mithraea can be dated between 100 BC and 300 AD, mostly in the Roman Empire.
